rationale: LGPL-2.1-only is the sole route this project's release audit accepts for LibRaw statically combined with the GPL-3.0-only application; CDDL-1.0 is not generally treated as GPL-compatible for that combination. LGPL-2.1 section 3 permits the combination with GPLv3, and the section 6 relink materials, corresponding source, notices and SBOM are built and verified by the release workflow. Local patch contributions under lib/libraw/patches are licensed under the same route.
